key_insight: Optimized SMAW parameters reduced the reported defect rate in AISI 4145 steel from 6% to 2.7%.
engineering_relevance: Parameter control can reduce weld rejection and improve manufacturing productivity for medium-carbon steel components.
method: Prioritize porosity and undercut using Pareto analysis of production defects.
Map root causes with Ishikawa diagrams.
Optimize current, voltage, and welding speed using a Taguchi L9 orthogonal array.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports optimal settings of 140 A, 40 V, and 80 mm/s, with current contributing 72.18% of the observed variation in tensile strength.
watch_item: Verify the reported welding-speed units and validate the settings for local joint geometry, electrodes, and thermal-treatment requirements before adoption.
paper_title: Mitigating Weld Defects in AISI 4145 Medium-Carbon Steel During Shielded Metal Arc Welding
